tickets.text: ABOVE_STRUCTURE, ext_atr20 2.15: price is away from value (R2, C3, C15). An hourly close above bar_high buys the extension, not the test; the trigger is not the one my method uses.
H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 54.7 and H1 last_bar red: supply met the break, no sign-of-strength bar yet (C12). Acting now on yesterday's high skips the bar my trigger requires.

ABOVE_STRUCTURE, ext_atr20 2.28, H1 LH/LL at pos_in_day_range_pct 72.9: a corrective wave may be starting (C3). An hourly close above pivot_high buys the high again instead of the test of the broken Creek (R2, C7).
